items.title: Government seeks reconstruction model for flood-damaged hydropower projects
items.summary: Kathmandu, September 30 The devastating flood in the Bhotekoshi River on August 26 caused extensive damage to hydropower projects in Rasuwa, Nuwakot and Dhading. items.title: Parliamentary climate committee begins work under Ganesh Parajuli
items.summary: Kathmandu, September 30 Ganesh Parajuli has been unanimously elected chair of the parliamentary special committee formed to study the impact of climate change in the Himalayas, climate justice and the Bhotekoshi-Trishuli disaster. items.title: Nepal flood survivors are leaving temporary camps as government delays rehabilitation
items.summary: Most displaced families have moved into rented rooms or elsewhere as makeshift shelters become uninhabitable and the government delays resettlement and promised financial assistance.

items.title: NDRRMA Chief Upreti on what Nepal must change after the Bhotekoshi disaster
items.summary: A month after the Bhotekoshi flood, Nepal’s disaster authorities are assessing the damage, planning reconstruction and considering the relocation of settlements in high-risk areas.
